facts.contentPolicy: Original paraphrases only; no third-party image, audio or video copied. Fictional personalities are explicitly separate and unset.

measurementPolicy.length: Retain the source label Length. Cornell and Audubon species measurement blocks do not explicitly define anatomical endpoints. source_endpoint_definition is null. Bill-tip-to-tail-tip is a common field-guide convention, not an explicit definition established by these cited profiles. Do not call these values body-only length.
measurementPolicy.mass: Source Weight values expressed in grams are recorded as mass; conditions, age and sample sizes are not supplied in the measurement blocks.
measurementPolicy.points_and_ranges: Published points remain points. They are not invented ranges, means or medians. Published ranges are source-specific summaries, not guaranteed population extrema or confidence intervals.
measurementPolicy.rendering: No scale factor, body-to-tail ratio or sprite bounding-box size is inferred. Calibration requires an explicitly defined anatomical landmark measurement and a matching, consistently posed asset. Wingspan must never substitute for length.
measurementPolicy.sex_age: Both Sexes is retained only where Cornell labels it. No nestling/fledgling dimensions are inferred. Sex-specific Mourning Dove fields remain separate.
measurementPolicy.wingspan: Retain source label Wingspan; conventionally the spread wingtip-to-wingtip distance, but the cited blocks do not detail posture or measurement protocol. It is not wing chord.
